name: Yulang Mirage
source: Yulang Mirage is the champion gladiator of the Leazas Castle Coliseum. Yulang is well-known throughout the nation as an undefeated warrior and a remarkable beauty, which make her very popular as a gladiator. Her reputation is so great that she has been hired by the royal family several times to accomplish difficult mercenary work.
